parcel.description: Situs address of the parcel containing the point, as the county records it: the address of the land itself, not the owner's mailing address and not the address in the request.
Assessor parcel number (APN) of the parcel containing the point, formatted as the county publishes it. Use parcelnumb_no_formatting to compare across sources.
Primary owner of the parcel as recorded by the county assessor. Owner names are as published (often upper case, sometimes with trust or LLC suffixes) and can lag a recent sale.

point.description: Parcel boundary as a GeoJSON geometry string (WGS84).
Geodesic footprint area in square metres of the primary Overture building (containing the point, else nearest within 100 m), merged across tile edges.

parcel.description: Geodesic footprint area in square metres of the primary Overture building (containing the point, else nearest within 100 m), merged across tile edges.

point.description: Maximum voltage (MAX_VOLT, kV) of the nearest mapped substation within 10 km. A voltage class, not available MW or transfer capability.

parcel.description: Maximum voltage (MAX_VOLT, kV) of the nearest mapped substation within 10 km. A voltage class, not available MW or transfer capability.
DERIVED upper bound of nameplate utility-scale PV on the gross parcel acreage (Regrid ll_gisacre / 5.5 ac/MWac). A sizing prior, not a design.

The most severe FEMA flood zone on the parcel (coastal V zones, then other Special Flood Hazard Area zones, then shaded X, then X; the larger area breaks ties), from NFHL polygons clipped to the parcel boundary. Method: Union of FEMA NFHL flood hazard polygons clipped to the parcel boundary in equal-area EPSG:5070. SFHA is FEMA's literal SFHA_TF flag. Area with no determined zone makes the fraction unavailable.

point.description: CAL FIRE OSFM Fire Hazard Severity Zone class at the point: Moderate, High, Very High or Non-Wildland. California only; a hazard classification, not a risk score.

parcel.description: CAL FIRE OSFM Fire Hazard Severity Zone class at the point: Moderate, High, Very High or Non-Wildland. California only; a hazard classification, not a risk score.

point.description: Hail events per year, area-weighted over the containing Census tract (FEMA NRI HAIL_AFREQ).

parcel.description: Hail events per year, area-weighted over the containing Census tract (FEMA NRI HAIL_AFREQ).
Description of the parcel's local zoning code (for example Planned Development Office Park), as published with the parcel record.

Parcel acreage (the boundary's equal-area EPSG:5070 area) minus the NWI wetland acres on the parcel, floored at 0. A screening proxy only: floodplain, easements, setbacks, slope and zoning are not subtracted (see the constraint roll-up for those). Method: Union of USFWS NWI wetland polygons clipped to the parcel boundary in equal-area EPSG:5070. An inventory, not a jurisdictional wetland determination.

point.description: Whether the point is inside a mapped EPA community water system service-area polygon. Mapped intersection only, not a connection, capacity or service offer; False does not prove no system serves the point (the dataset covers about 99% of consumers).

parcel.description: Whether the point is inside a mapped EPA community water system service-area polygon. Mapped intersection only, not a connection, capacity or service offer; False does not prove no system serves the point (the dataset covers about 99% of consumers).

point.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest point of the nearest Overture motorway / trunk / primary / secondary road within 5 km.

parcel.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest point of the nearest Overture motorway / trunk / primary / secondary road within 5 km.

point.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest usable BTS NTAD / FRA North American Rail Network line segment (searched up to 200 km); abandoned, removed, trail and out-of-service segments (NET A, R, T, X) are excluded.

parcel.description: Geodesic distance to the nearest usable BTS NTAD / FRA North American Rail Network line segment (searched up to 200 km); abandoned, removed, trail and out-of-service segments (NET A, R, T, X) are excluded.

point.description: Whether at least one ISP reports fiber (FTTP) mass-market availability in the FCC BDC H3 res-8 hexagon containing the point; an availability floor for the hexagon, not the parcel. Operator keys only.

parcel.description: Whether at least one ISP reports fiber (FTTP) mass-market availability in the FCC BDC H3 res-8 hexagon containing the point; an availability floor for the hexagon, not the parcel. Operator keys only.

point.description: Count of distinct ISPs reporting fiber (FTTP) mass-market availability in the FCC BDC H3 res-8 hexagon containing the point (June 2024 release via Esri's Living Atlas copy). Operator keys only (copy rights not recorded for public serving).

parcel.description: Count of distinct ISPs reporting fiber (FTTP) mass-market availability in the FCC BDC H3 res-8 hexagon containing the point (June 2024 release via Esri's Living Atlas copy). Operator keys only (copy rights not recorded for public serving).

point.description: Best modelled 5G-NR coverage tier any carrier reports for the FCC BDC H3 res-9 hexagon containing the point: '5G NR 35/3 In-Vehicle', '5G NR 35/3 Outdoor Stationary', '5G NR 7/1 In-Vehicle' or '5G NR 7/1 Outdoor Stationary' (computed from provider rows). Operator keys only.

parcel.description: Best modelled 5G-NR coverage tier any carrier reports for the FCC BDC H3 res-9 hexagon containing the point: '5G NR 35/3 In-Vehicle', '5G NR 35/3 Outdoor Stationary', '5G NR 7/1 In-Vehicle' or '5G NR 7/1 Outdoor Stationary' (computed from provider rows). Operator keys only.
Price of the most recent recorded sale, in US dollars, as published in the parcel record. Some states do not disclose sale prices, so it is often missing.
Date of the most recent recorded sale of the parcel, as published in the parcel record (ISO date text).
Total assessed or appraised value of the parcel (land plus improvements) in US dollars, as the county reports it. The basis (market, assessed, appraised) varies by county; see parvaltype.
Basis of the county's parcel value (for example market, assessed or appraised), so parval can be read correctly.

point.description: Total residential housing units authorized by building permits in the county in 2025 (Census BPS: 1-unit + 2-unit + 3-4 unit + 5+ unit Units).

parcel.description: Total residential housing units authorized by building permits in the county in 2025 (Census BPS: 1-unit + 2-unit + 3-4 unit + 5+ unit Units).

point.description: Single-family (1-unit) housing units authorized by building permits in the county in 2025 (Census BPS annual county file, 1-unit Units).

parcel.description: Single-family (1-unit) housing units authorized by building permits in the county in 2025 (Census BPS annual county file, 1-unit Units).

point.description: Percent change in total permitted housing units in the county, 2025 vs 2024 (Census BPS).

parcel.description: Percent change in total permitted housing units in the county, 2025 vs 2024 (Census BPS).

point.description: Total 2020 Census population of the tract (CenPop2020 tract file).

parcel.description: Total 2020 Census population of the tract (CenPop2020 tract file).

point.description: Median household income of the county containing the point, 2024 dollars (ACS 2020-2024 5-year, B19013).

parcel.description: Median household income of the county containing the point, 2024 dollars (ACS 2020-2024 5-year, B19013).

point.description: Geodesic distance in metres to the nearest open grocery store or supermarket in Overture places (US, confidence >= 0.5, open or unknown status), searched to 100 km.

parcel.description: Geodesic distance in metres to the nearest open grocery store or supermarket in Overture places (US, confidence >= 0.5, open or unknown status), searched to 100 km.

point.description: Name, as filed with CMS, of the hospital that nearest_acute_care_hospital_distance_m measures to.

parcel.description: Name, as filed with CMS, of the hospital that nearest_acute_care_hospital_distance_m measures to.

point.description: Name of the Census unified school district containing the point (current TIGERweb boundary), e.g. Loudoun County Public Schools.

parcel.description: Name of the Census unified school district containing the point (current TIGERweb boundary), e.g. Loudoun County Public Schools.

point.description: Geodesic distance in metres to the nearest open fire station in Overture places (US, confidence >= 0.5, open or unknown status), searched to 100 km.

parcel.description: Geodesic distance in metres to the nearest open fire station in Overture places (US, confidence >= 0.5, open or unknown status), searched to 100 km.

point.description: Most frequent crop class at the 30 m cell over the last five USDA Cropland Data Layer editions (non-crop classes ignored; ties go to the crop seen most recently). Smooths over corn-soy rotation; the per-year history is in notes.

parcel.description: Most frequent crop class at the 30 m cell over the last five USDA Cropland Data Layer editions (non-crop classes ignored; ties go to the crop seen most recently). Smooths over corn-soy rotation; the per-year history is in notes.

point.description: Natural drainage class (e.g. Well drained, Poorly drained) of the dominant component of the SSURGO map unit at the point.

parcel.description: Natural drainage class (e.g. Well drained, Poorly drained) of the dominant component of the SSURGO map unit at the point.

point.description: US Drought Monitor category at the point on the current weekly map: D0 (Abnormally Dry) to D4 (Exceptional Drought), the highest of the nested severity polygons containing the point.

parcel.description: US Drought Monitor category at the point on the current weekly map: D0 (Abnormally Dry) to D4 (Exceptional Drought), the highest of the nested severity polygons containing the point.

point.description: TMY-based approximation of the 0.4% cooling design wet bulb: the 99.6th percentile of hourly wet bulb over one NREL NSRDB GOES TMY year (tmy-2024), solved psychrometrically from dry bulb and dew point at the hour's station pressure.

parcel.description: TMY-based approximation of the 0.4% cooling design wet bulb: the 99.6th percentile of hourly wet bulb over one NREL NSRDB GOES TMY year (tmy-2024), solved psychrometrically from dry bulb and dew point at the hour's station pressure.

point.description: 1991-2020 annual mean temperature normal (degC, anntavg_norm = mean of the twelve monthly normals) from NOAA U.S. Monthly Gridded Climate Normals v1.0 (NCEI 0245564) on the 1/24° (~4.6 km) nClimGrid grid, rounded to 0.1 as NOAA instructs. CONUS only.

parcel.description: 1991-2020 annual mean temperature normal (degC, anntavg_norm = mean of the twelve monthly normals) from NOAA U.S. Monthly Gridded Climate Normals v1.0 (NCEI 0245564) on the 1/24° (~4.6 km) nClimGrid grid, rounded to 0.1 as NOAA instructs. CONUS only.

point.description: Hours in one NSRDB GOES TMY v4 tmy-2024 year with dry-bulb temperature at or below 15 C: a dry-bulb airside-economizer proxy, not an energy model.

parcel.description: Hours in one NSRDB GOES TMY v4 tmy-2024 year with dry-bulb temperature at or below 15 C: a dry-bulb airside-economizer proxy, not an energy model.
